answer: Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the sonnet checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. The trellis graph is rebuilt each epoch, and hence the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the timber audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 6 times its size, so a group of 65 keys loses far more than 65 single identities would. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
